blocks.value: And awards 0.15 CEUs (Continuing Education Units)  for successful completion of 1.5 hours of interactive, self-paced instruction training course. This online course includes interactive modules on legal definitions, protected categories, virtual misconduct, employee rights, and digital reporting procedures

Certificate affirms the recipient has completed an approved online training program in accordance with U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) standards and applicable state-specific harassment prevention mandates.
